product_009_brief.lead_hook_reason: Highest average views across CONFIRMED runs (229.5 vs 158.0/157.5/116.0) and, for the first time, the most reliable 2-second retention average (42.8%) once Problem/Solution's tiny-sample outlier (003C, 1 view) is excluded -- Problem/Solution has the higher raw win count (2/4 vs 1/4) but that edge does not hold up once retention data is factored in.
product_009_brief.first_frame_requirement: standard approach -- 2s retention is WEAK-to-MARGINAL but not CRITICAL on any statistically meaningful variant, meaning the hook itself is not the primary problem
product_009_brief.pacing_adjustment: shorten and tighten the mid-video (5-13s) segments -- average watch time is POOR (<25% of the 15s runtime) on 13 of 16 variants, including several high-view variants; viewers consistently leave well before the video ends regardless of hook type
product_009_brief.cta_adjustment: no data yet -- cta_code_comments has never been collected for any product; this is now the top data-quality gap
product_009_brief.storyboard_notes: consider testing a shorter/faster-paced middle section as an explicit experiment, given how consistent the watch-time drop-off is across every hook type and product tested so far. This is the first analysis run backed by complete saves/shares/watch-time/retention data -- prior PROCEED decisions (including 2026-07-01's) were built on incomplete data per PROJECT_STATUS.md.
